text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Biko Pegasus got injured, so I hurriedly brought her to the infirmary...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, even in tough times like these,
a hero never gives up!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how many times monsters beat him, Carrotman
always stood back up... And so will I!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
If this is a trial, I've gotta overcome it!
Right, Trainer?!
choice_data_list: ...If I think it's dangerous, I'll stop it right away, okay?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Urrrgh... And here I thought
you of all people would understand, Trainer...!
choice_data_list: Don't you lose to the enemy called impatience!
Don't lose to the enemy called impatience!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Impatience...
I see. I was getting ahead of myself, wasn't I...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah, I understand. I'll focus on recovering for now."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The pain'll go away soon, right?
I'm allowed to rest, right...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Though she seemed to accept it for now, Biko Pegasus still wore an anxious expression...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer!
Alright then, back to special training we go!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ouch... 
It hurts even more than before...
choice_data_list: Let's stop here and focus on recovery.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Got it...
Dammit... I wanted to keep trying...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Biko Pegasus dedicated himself to treatment... but it would take a long time before he could make his comeback.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*...!
Yeah! I think I can do this!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'll turn this crisis into an opportunity!
Just like Carrot Man said!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to a gradual rehabilitation process,
Biko Pegasus was able to make a safe recovery
from the injury.
